name: player_reactivate_copter_snd_nodes_if_healthy
description: Player::ReactivateCopterSndNodesIfHealthy re-enables cached copter sound nodes when their healthy child is active and resumes their cached play handles.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded for this Player copter sound helper; tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x42b5a0 validates the cdecl ABI, healthy-node globals, active-flag bit 0x04 at zClass_NodePartial+0x24, sound-node globals, gwNodeSetActive(node, 1), sound payload at node+0x38, zClass_SoundDataPartial::playHandle at payload+0x4, and zSndPlayHandle::PlayWithDelta_BackendDispatch(g_Player_CopterSndSample, playHandle, 0, 0.0f) for each cached copter.

The native smoke verifies both healthy copter sound nodes are activated and replayed, while an inactive healthy node and a missing cached play handle suppress replay as in the Binary Ninja branch structure.
